about: The largest output of each image model on roster.md, per requested aspect ratio, as WIDTHxHEIGHT. check-render.py reads it (design-vault#328). A model is keyed by its Higgsfield endpoint id, or for a render made by hand by the id given to --model. Add a size only from the docs or a render of the model's largest tier.

marketing-studio/image/sunburst.name: GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst
marketing-studio/image/sunburst.note: 4k is offered at about $1 an image, past the house's max_usd 0.6 cap (prompts.md §GPT Image 2.5), so the largest size the house may request is 2k's. 4k's size is not on record; measure it into this row if the cap lifts.

16:9.source: measured: the 30 Sep calibration renders r1–r3/v12-gpt-sunburst.png and design-vault#52's r1/v1-gpt-sunburst-palette.png, quality high (roster.md, design-vault#51)
